gesture: one per hover, focus or replay; settles in 1.0 to 1.3 seconds

car-rental.label: Car rental
car-rental.description: A low coupe cast in ice-blue alloy, with inset glass and machined wheels.
car-rental.motion: The wheels take a short turn; headlights answer once.

ofm.label: Creator management
ofm.description: A portrait medallion with a soft spotlight and a polished editorial star.
ofm.motion: The portrait spotlight opens gently and the star gives one restrained glint.

ecommerce.label: Ecommerce
ecommerce.description: An isometric parcel with folded metal faces and a luminous packing ribbon.
ecommerce.motion: The parcel lid lifts slightly, then closes into its original seam.

restaurants.label: Restaurants
restaurants.description: A polished service cloche over a sculpted serving tray.
restaurants.motion: The cloche lifts to release a small wisp of steam, then settles.

tour-guides.label: Tour guides
tour-guides.description: A pocket compass with a faceted navigation needle in deep glass.
tour-guides.motion: The needle searches a few degrees, overshoots, and finds its bearing.

crypto-trading.label: Crypto trading
crypto-trading.description: Three mixed market candles on a machined instrument axis; an illustrative symbol, not market data.
crypto-trading.motion: The candles briefly redraw in place and recover; no rising-price or profit signal.

library.label: Great Library of SISO
library.description: An open illuminated book inside the architecture of a knowledge archive.
library.motion: The right page lifts from its spine, catches the light, and settles.

estate.label: SISO Estate
estate.description: A protected home within a faceted shield: the assets and systems SISO owns.
estate.motion: The inner home seats into its shield as a security glint passes upward.

web.label: Web
web.description: A luminous world held in a machined circular rim, with a precise navigation pointer.
web.motion: The globe meridian turns once across the glass as a light travels its rim.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: A custom emerald message bubble and sculpted ivory handset.
whatsapp.motion: The handset gives one brief two-part ring and returns to rest.

lifelog.label: LifeLog
lifelog.description: A bound personal chronicle with an inset timepiece; entirely synthetic artwork.
lifelog.motion: The clock hand advances through a measured turn, then settles at its starting time.

rolodex.label: Rolodex
rolodex.description: Layered contact cards with a bold portrait cutout and polished binding feet.
rolodex.motion: The rear cards fan apart briefly, then stack neatly again.

siso-voice.label: SISO Voice
siso-voice.description: A sculpted microphone capsule in a luminous cradle with responsive wave bars.
siso-voice.motion: The side waves answer in a short staggered phrase and settle.

agent-base.label: Agent Base · Beacon
agent-base.description: A distinct three-sided architectural beacon surrounding a suspended intelligence core.
agent-base.motion: The inner core rises and brightens; three rays briefly appear before it seats again.

maths-innovations.label: Maths Innovations
maths-innovations.description: An interwoven infinity ribbon with a crystalline proof at its centre.
maths-innovations.motion: A point of light follows the ribbon once, then rests at the proof.
